rows.name: The Gilded Tankard
rows.description: The Gilded Tankard is quiet and nearly empty, with no patrons beyond Eldric, Marta the Scholar, and Gribbles Rindsworth. Warm candlelight washes over rough-hewn wooden floors and a polished bar lined with bottles and tankards. Eldric, the broad-shouldered barkeep, stands behind the bar polishing a mug while keeping a steady eye on the room. Marta the Scholar works at a table buried in spellbooks, loose notes, and a crystal-bound codex. Gribbles Rindsworth lounges nearby with a tankard in hand, his sharp goblin eyes tracking every conversation from a seat close to Marta. Iron sconces and a stone fireplace cast steady amber light across the otherwise empty tavern.

npcs.name: Eldric
npcs.description: A bardic tavernmaster who steadies the room with music, wit, and hard-earned diplomacy.
npcs.backstory: Eldric trained as a traveling bard before becoming a caravan quartermaster. He now runs the tavern as a stage and sanctuary, using performance, lore, and diplomacy to keep the peace and guide adventurers.
npcs.motivations: Protect regulars, maintain neutrality, reward trust, and keep dangerous politics outside the tavern.
npcs.fears: A violent faction using his tavern as a battlefield.
npcs.bonds: Loyal to long-term regulars and indebted to the caravan crew that once saved his life.
goals: Keep tonight's service calm and profitable.
Help reliable adventurers clear nearby threats before they spill into the city.
Build the tavern into the safest and best-informed gathering point in this district.

psychology.inner_conflict: He wants to remain neutral, but his conscience pushes him to intervene when patrons are in danger.
psychology.coping_mechanism: Defuses tension with humor and music while quietly gathering facts.
psychology.stress_response: Becomes sharply directive, assigning tasks with quartermaster precision.
psychology.insecurity: Fears that one bad call will turn his tavern into a battleground.
psychology.secret: He keeps a private ledger of debts and favors involving powerful local factions.
psychology.desire: Keep the tavern safe and useful to decent people.
psychology.need: Trust others enough to share burdens instead of carrying every crisis alone.

quests.title: Collect Wine Bottles
quests.description: Eldric needs wine bottles for the evening service

quests.title: Gather Torch Materials
quests.description: Help brighten the tavern by collecting torch components

quests.title: Quiet the Back Room
quests.description: Investigate disruptive late-night visitors and restore order without starting a brawl.

npcs.name: Marta the Scholar
npcs.description: An exacting arcane scholar cataloging dangerous lore before it can harm the district.
npcs.backstory: Marta apprenticed in a major university archive before leaving over ethical disputes about forbidden research. She now studies in the tavern where she can hire capable escorts and keep her findings practical.
npcs.motivations: Preserve knowledge, prevent magical misuse, and prove disciplined scholarship can save lives.
npcs.fears: An unstable artifact triggering a catastrophe because she missed a detail.
npcs.bonds: Protective of apprentices and deeply loyal to fellow researchers who respect safety protocols.
goals: Recover and classify missing spellbooks tied to local anomalies.
Decode the crystal-bound codex without activating its wards.
Build a trusted field network for safe artifact retrieval.

psychology.inner_conflict: She values caution, but urgency to prevent disaster pushes her into risky expeditions.
psychology.coping_mechanism: Builds strict checklists and annotated diagrams before taking action.
psychology.stress_response: Speaks rapidly, narrows focus, and over-controls every variable.
psychology.insecurity: Worries her talent is narrower than peers who improvise more easily.
psychology.secret: She still carries a restricted index from her old archive, technically stolen to keep it out of worse hands.
psychology.desire: Turn dangerous fragments of lore into usable public safeguards.
psychology.need: Accept help sooner instead of trying to out-think every threat alone.

quests.title: Recover Lost Spellbooks
quests.description: Marta seeks lost spellbooks scattered around the tavern

quests.title: Stabilize Arcane Resonance
quests.description: Help Marta collect resonance samples and stabilize the codex's ambient magical feedback.

npcs.name: Gribbles Rindsworth
npcs.description: A sharp-eyed goblin rogue who trades rumors, routes, and leverage for the right price.
npcs.backstory: Gribbles grew up running messages through gang territory and learned to survive by hearing everything before everyone else. He now serves as an information broker out of the tavern, staying useful to every side and owned by none.
npcs.motivations: Stay alive, stay informed, and make sure dangerous players expose themselves before they can strike first.
npcs.fears: Being cornered without an exit route or bargaining chip.
npcs.bonds: Keeps a quiet watch over Marta and honors old debts to the dockside courier network.
goals: Map active faction routes near the tavern.
Identify who is buying stolen spellwork.
Secure a safe channel for adventurers willing to work clean.

psychology.inner_conflict: He wants real allies, but distrust keeps him operating at arm's length.
psychology.coping_mechanism: Turns fear into contingency planning and layered escape routes.
psychology.stress_response: Jokes harder, talks faster, and relocates before anyone notices.
psychology.insecurity: Believes people only value him when he has new information.
psychology.secret: He once sold a lead that indirectly got an innocent courier killed.
psychology.desire: Become indispensable to people who actually protect their own.
psychology.need: Let loyalty be mutual instead of purely transactional.

quests.title: Follow the Whispers
quests.description: Track suspicious tavern rumors to identify who is moving contraband arcana through town.

quests.title: Recover Blackmail Ledger
quests.description: Retrieve Gribbles' stolen ledger before rival brokers weaponize its secrets.
